value.value: As of the Closing Date, the Aggregate Commitments equal to US$15,000,000,000.
value.note: verbatim: ““ Aggregate Commitments ” means, at any time, the Commitments of all the Lenders at such time. As of the Closing Date, the Aggregate Commitments equal to US$15,000,000,000.”

value.value: each Term SOFR Borrowing shall bear interest ... at a rate per annum equal to the Term SOFR for such Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate
value.note: verbatim: “(i) each Term SOFR Borrowing shall bear interest on the outstanding principal amount thereof for the Interest Period applicable to such Borrowing at a rate per annum equal to the Term SOFR for such Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate;”

component_quotes.margin_pct: “ Applicable Rate ” means (a) with respect to Base Rate Loans, 0.00% per annum, (b) with respect to Term Benchmark Loans and RFR Loans, 0.45% per annum and (c) with respect to the commitment fee set forth in Section 2.07(a) , 0.03% per annum.
component_quotes.floor_pct: provided that if the Term SOFR as so determined would be less than zero, such rate shall be deemed to be zero.

value.value: the later of (a) November 1, 2028 and (b) if maturity is extended pursuant to Section 2.12 , such extended maturity date as determined pursuant to such Section
value.note: verbatim: ““ Maturity Date ” means the later of (a) November 1, 2028 and (b) if maturity is extended pursuant to Section 2.12 , such extended maturity date as determined pursuant to such Section; provided that, in each case, if such date is not a Business Day, the Maturity Date shall be the immediately preceding Business Day.”
